helpTopics.title: File intake
helpTopics.summary: Choose one supported file, review its metadata, then explicitly authorize an app-owned copy.
helpTopics.boundary: The source path is not stored; folders, archives, handoff, and automatic processing remain blocked.

helpTopics.title: Capability lanes
helpTopics.summary: Compare supported input kinds with their planned route and detected tool family.
helpTopics.boundary: A preview-ready lane is not execution-ready and cannot launch a tool.

helpTopics.title: Tool setup
helpTopics.summary: Read-only detection checks PATH and normal install locations without starting software.
helpTopics.boundary: Install, update, repair, uninstall, and launch actions remain blocked.

helpTopics.title: Workflow preview
helpTopics.summary: Current metadata is mapped into route, output, gate, and job plans.
helpTopics.boundary: Plans create no command, process, output, or selected-file handoff.

helpTopics.title: Output proof
helpTopics.summary: Expected artifacts and evidence requirements stay beside the selected work plan.
helpTopics.boundary: Nothing is called complete until a real artifact and its required proof exist.

helpTopics.title: Workbench settings
helpTopics.summary: Density, motion, and contextual help are stored in the operating system user-data location.
helpTopics.boundary: Settings contain no personal path, source checkout location, file content, or tool action.
